objective: Improve four-way text sentiment preference scoring with legitimate independent source annotations and prompt/response format diversity.

source_candidate.name: GoEmotions
source_candidate.annotation_type: Original human emotion annotations; constructed valence mapping is not a human-reviewed sentiment preference.
source_candidate.inventory_requirement: Read all three raw annotation files, aggregate distinct raters by original comment and preserve author/thread/time separation.
source_candidate.scope: English Reddit emotion-to-valence proxy. Mixed requires positive and negative emotion evidence; ambiguous emotions are excluded. Neutral uses original Neutral annotations. This is not universal factual proof.

boundaries.audit: New independent grouped source slice, measured once per frozen candidate
exclusions: Original UCI audit as a new audit
